title: Watch list
description: What the next run should check. Written by the EOD brief, read by the next EOD brief and by morning-note. This is how an intent survives a session that has no memory.

what_to_check.description: Specific and observable. 'Watch NVDA' is not a watch item; 'NVDA reports Wed after close — check data-center revenue against the 8% sequential guide' is.

why.description: Which thesis or limit this bears on.

due.description: When it resolves, where known — an earnings date, a data release.

resolves_to.description: data_gap means something the last run could not source and should retry.

carried_forward.description: How many items have rolled over more than five sessions. A high number means items are being written that nobody resolves — prune them rather than accumulating.
